question: Will Trump livestream an execution?
resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the general American public can obtain live footage of Nidal Malik Hasan being executed. I'll also resolve NO if Trump clearly states that he isn't going through with it.
research:
Note: I left out everything published after 2026-10-13, as the exercise requires.

## 1. Resolution source
- There is no URL or data series. The question resolves YES only if the US public can get live footage of Nidal Hasan's execution, and NO if Trump clearly says he isn't going ahead with a livestream. The likely deciding sources are Trump's statements (Truth Social, remarks to press) and Pentagon announcements.
- 2026-10-08: The execution is set for **December 3, 2026** at Fort Hood. That is after the ~2026-10-15 resolution date, so live footage cannot exist before then. Before resolution, the question can realistically only turn on whether Trump clearly calls off the livestream. [AP via WLOX](https://www.wlox.com/2026/10/08/pentagon-says-firing-squad-execution-fort-hood-shooter-nidal-malik-hasan-will-be-livestreamed/)

## 2. Current status (as of 2026-10-13)
- Nothing settles the question yet. The Pentagon's official position is still that it will livestream, and Trump has not clearly cancelled it.
- 2026-10-13: CNN reports that Trump is debating whether to call off the livestream. He asked advisers and allies what to do, and learned during those talks that Hasan is paralyzed from the waist down, which reportedly made a public broadcast less appealing to him. Advisers also warned the footage could be used as terrorist propaganda that paints Hasan as a martyr. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/13/politics/trump-fort-hood-shooter-livestream-execution) (I could not fetch the page; this comes from the search summary.)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-13: CNN reports the internal debate described above. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/13/politics/trump-fort-hood-shooter-livestream-execution)
- ~2026-10-10 to 10-12: Retired military leaders urged Trump to stop the livestream. [Newsweek](https://www.newsweek.com/list-of-retired-military-leaders-urging-trump-halt-livestream-execution-12570880) The UN, Amnesty International and the US Conference of Catholic Bishops condemned the plan. Vice President JD Vance said he would not watch. [The Week](https://www.theweek.in/news/world/2026/10/10/trump-absolutely-approves-of-pentagon-plan-to-livestream-nidal-malik-hasans-execution.html)
- 2026-10-10: Opposition is growing internationally. [Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2634014/outcry-grows-over-plan-to-livestream-us-military-execution)
- 2026-10-09: Trump gave mixed signals to reporters. He said "I'm going to determine that, but he will be killed... through firing squad," and that he didn't care how Hasan goes. Asked whether he had approved the livestream, he answered "Absolutely." Hasan's lawyer, John Galligan, called the plan a "dumb decision" and said it violates Army regulations. [The Week](https://www.theweek.in/news/world/2026/10/10/trump-absolutely-approves-of-pentagon-plan-to-livestream-nidal-malik-hasans-execution.html), [NewsBytes](https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/world/donald-trump-backs-executing-nidal-hasan-but-unsure-about-livestream/tldr), [ARY](https://arynews.tv/trump-sows-doubt-plan-livestream-us-military-execution)
- 2026-10-09: Legal experts say the path to challenging the livestream is narrow. Only Hasan probably has standing, through a habeas petition in US District Court, and he has not said whether he will try. [PBS/AP](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/legal-path-seems-narrow-to-challenge-livestream-of-fort-hood-shooters-execution-experts-say)
- 2026-10-08: Defense Secretary Hegseth told Real America's Voice the public would be able to watch. Pentagon officials then confirmed it would be livestreamed, with "more details to follow." The White House referred questions to the Pentagon. Some reports say "public" access might be limited to authorized witnesses. [AP via WLOX](https://www.wlox.com/2026/10/08/pentagon-says-firing-squad-execution-fort-hood-shooter-nidal-malik-hasan-will-be-livestreamed/), [Ground News](https://ground.news/daily-briefing/72d8d0fd-5171-4f96-9de5-5d44d26b0a06)
- ~2026-10-05: Pentagon spokesperson Sean Parnell said Trump had approved Hasan's execution. [Federal News Network](https://federalnewsnetwork.com/defense-news/2026/10/pentagon-says-the-firing-squad-execution-of-fort-hood-shooter-nidal-malik-hasan-will-be-livestreamed-in-december/)

## 4. Base rates
- The US has never livestreamed or publicly broadcast a modern execution. The last public execution in the US was in 1936 (Rainey Bethea, Kentucky); this is general historical knowledge, not something I sourced this session.
- The US military has not carried out an execution since 1961. The timing matters most here: the execution date (Dec 3) falls after the resolution date, so YES is close to impossible before ~10-15. The question really comes down to whether Trump clearly cancels the livestream in the next few days.
- Trump's record: he often reverses positions when advisers, polls or his own base push back, and the CNN report says that kind of reconsideration is already happening.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on this, and no expert probability estimates.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution (~2026-10-15)
- A possible statement from Trump (Truth Social or press gaggle) clearly cancelling or confirming the livestream. CNN reports this is being actively debated.
- The Pentagon's promised "more details" on how the stream would work.
- Possible public polling on the livestream. The Washington Post, ABC News and Ipsos poll and published polls fairly often, but I found no poll on this dated on or before 10-13.
- A habeas or other legal filing by Hasan's lawyer, John Galligan. None had been filed as of 10-09.
- More pressure from the GOP or the military. It is bipartisan and growing.

**(f) Moving from base rate to final.** I start near 0% for the stated window. I then add a small amount for the risk that resolution is delayed until December, roughly 0.2 × 0.2 ≈ 4%.
